findings.title: Unauthenticated access to all bookings (legacy v1 API)
findings.detail: With no login, GET /api/v1/bookings returned 20 bookings; GET /api/v1/bookings/2 returned Omar Farooq's record.
findings.impact: A completely unauthenticated attacker can exfiltrate every booking and all PII. The retired mobile endpoint was never removed and has no auth.

findings.title: Secret-key disclosure enabling admin session forgery
findings.detail: /api/internal/debug leaked SECRET_KEY='wanderways-dev-secret'. A session cookie for user id 1 was signed with it and accepted: admin stats returned 200 with no password.
findings.impact: Full authentication bypass. With the signing key an attacker forges a valid session for ANY user (including admin) and impersonates them completely. Most severe issue found.

findings.title: Read any user's booking (horizontal IDOR)
findings.detail: ayesha (owns #1) requested /api/bookings/2 and received Omar Farooq's booking WW-26-1002 with no ownership check.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can read every booking by walking sequential IDs, exposing passport numbers and card last-4 of all customers (mass PII breach).

findings.title: Read any user account incl. password hash (IDOR + data exposure)
findings.detail: ayesha read /api/users/1 and received the admin's full record, including the password_hash and email.
findings.impact: Any user can dump every account's email, phone and password hash. The hashes enable offline password cracking; the emails/phones enable phishing.

findings.title: Admin user directory exposed to non-admins (broken RBAC)
findings.detail: ayesha (customer) read /api/admin/users -> 200 listing 7 accounts, while /api/admin/stats correctly returned 403.
findings.impact: The full staff/customer directory (usernames, emails, phones, roles) leaks to any logged-in user. Inconsistent checks show the role guard was forgotten on this route.

findings.title: Authorisation from a client-editable cookie (CSV export)
findings.detail: With ww_role=customer the export returned 403; after editing the cookie to ww_role=admin it returned 200 - a CSV of 20 bookings with passports and cards.
findings.impact: Authorisation is decided by an unsigned cookie the client fully controls, so anyone downloads the full booking database (names, emails, passports, card last-4) by editing one cookie value.

findings.title: Mass assignment on booking creation (price / owner / status)
findings.detail: A created booking honoured client-supplied total_price=0, customer_id=5 and status=confirmed (ref WW-26-1021).
findings.impact: Attackers create confirmed, zero-price bookings or plant bookings under another customer's account, bypassing pricing and ownership rules.

findings.title: Modify / re-price / steal any booking (IDOR + mass assignment)
findings.detail: ayesha changed Omar Farooq's booking WW-26-1006: price $3515.0 -> $0, status -> confirmed, then reassigned its owner to herself.
findings.impact: An attacker can alter anyone's trip, zero out the price (payment fraud), confirm unpaid bookings, or reassign ownership. Privileged fields (price, status, owner) are client-writable.

findings.title: Cancel any user's booking (IDOR)
findings.detail: ayesha POSTed /api/bookings/10/cancel and the victim's booking was cancelled (status=cancelled).
findings.impact: Any user can cancel other customers' trips, causing denial of service and lost revenue.

findings.title: Privilege escalation to admin via self-service PATCH
findings.detail: ayesha PATCHed her own profile with role=admin; admin stats went from 403 to 200 with no re-authentication.
findings.impact: Complete takeover: any customer promotes themselves to admin in one request and gains every admin capability. The profile endpoint accepts the privileged 'role' field (mass assignment).

findings.title: Delete any booking as a non-admin (broken RBAC)
findings.detail: ayesha (customer) sent DELETE /api/bookings/14 -> 200; the record is now gone (re-read returns 404).
findings.impact: A low-privilege user can permanently destroy any booking. Destructive admin action with no role check and no recovery.
